title: My Neighbor Texted Me That My Cat Has a Secret Second Family #shorts #textstory
description:
I thought Biscuit was just big-boned. My neighbor had other news.

Follow for new stories every day.

#textstory #shorts #funnytexts #cats

messages.text: Hi. Your cat is living a double life.
Your neighbor. Blue house. He eats dinner here every night.
Biscuit? He eats at home. Twice a day.
Here he's called Captain. He eats three times a day.
That explains why he's so round
My vet says he needs a diet.
Your VET?? You took my cat to a vet?
messages.say: Your vet?! You took my cat to a vet?

messages.text: He's fully vaccinated now. You're welcome.
So is he. At MY vet. Twice now apparently.
messages.say: So is he. At my vet. Twice now, apparently.

messages.text: Weird question. Does he wear a red collar at your place?
He wears one at the yellow house.
And a little bow tie at the house on the corner.
How many families does my cat HAVE
messages.say: How many families does my cat have?!

messages.text: We just made a group chat. There are six of us.

end: Six families. One cat. Nobody owns Biscuit. Biscuit owns us.
end_say: Six families. One cat. Nobody owns Biscuit. Biscuit owns us.
